messages:
Ben: Quick thread to coordinate Priya's on-call onboarding + shadowing. Priya starts shadowing next Monday (3/23). I'm primary for that week; Jorge will be secondary. Goal: get Priya familiar with paging flow, runbooks, handoffs, and a short simulated page. Please read the onboarding runbook and drop which 1:1 shadow slots you can do. Runbook: https://redwood-infra/internal/runbooks/oncall-onboarding :memo:

Jorge: +1. Suggested handoff template (please copy into your handoff message):
- primary: NAME (timezone)
- secondary: NAME (timezone)
- active incidents: LIST
- recent deploys: commit shas or PR links
- customer-facing impacts: yes/no and notes
- escalation steps (pager -> oncall lead -> infra manager)

Example commands you'll use:```
/ack 12345  # acknowledge alert in pager
/oncall escalate --to=ben  # internal escalation helper
kubectl logs -n prod svc-frontend -c app --tail=200
```

Maya: Priya — happy to do a 1h pairing slot on Tue 9-10am PT to walk through the incident bot and our tracing dashboard. Also will demo the console tracing hooks. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks! I read the runbook but two quick q's: 1) If a P1 fires when I'm shadowing, do I ack or does the primary always do it? 2) Where do we record customer impact assessments during an incident?

Ben: Good q's. If you're actively shadowing, let the primary (me/Jorge) do the ack so we can narrate the decisions and talk through calls. You should still watch and ask questions out loud. For customer impact assessments we use the incident doc template in the runbook and the customer-impact section in the incident playbook (link above). We also paste the short summary into the #incidents channel when we triage.

oncall-bot: [SCHEDULE REMINDER] Priya's shadowing week starts in 7 days. Please add your shadow slots: https://calendar.redwood/in/oncall-shadow

Sam: I can cover the weekend oncall for Priya's second week (Sat/Sun), if that helps with exposure to out-of-hours paging. Happy to be secondary during any practice pages.

Jorge: I'll add a short checklist to the runbook for handoffs:
- confirm who is primary and secondary (with timezones)
- ensure no ongoing rollouts > 30m ago
- share last 24h error/slo graphs
- confirm access (k8s, tracing, logs, KMS)
- note any open customer tickets
I'll paste the checklist to the runbook after this thread.

incident-bot: [ALERT] 3165009999 - PROD latency spike detected (p95 > 2s) - paged channel: #eng-oncall - urgency: P2 - affected service: inference-runtime-main

Ben: Reacting to the simulated alert (this is scheduled test). Priya — watch me acknowledge and run the first triage steps.

Ben: /ack 3165009999  
Ben: Checkpoint 1: identify whether the spike is region-specific. Command: `curl -s https://monitoring.internal/api/alerts/3165009999` -> look for region tag.

Priya: Got it — watching now. I see the alert shows region: us-west-2 and increased queue depth on worker-gpu-7.

Jorge: If you see increased queue depth, run these quick checks: `kubectl top pod -n inference` and `redis-cli --latency` (we've seen redis latency cause queuing). If redis is slow, failover to replica set per runbook section 4.2.

Priya: Noted. If I was primary, I'd also post a short customer-facing line: "We're investigating elevated latency for inference; some requests may be delayed. We'll update in 15 minutes." Is that the right cadence?

Ben: Yes, that's perfect. Short, factual, and updated every 15m until mitigated. After mitigation we fill the customer-impact block with timeline + root cause guess and follow-up items.

Maya: For onboarding tasks, I'll give Priya two simulated pages during week 1 (one daytime, one evening) — both will be labelled TEST in the alert so they don't escalate. We usually do 3 shadowed pages total: 2 observational, 1 hands-on (where you ack).

Priya: Sounds great. Can someone add me to the test-pager rotation and the oncall runbook edit perms? I currently only have read.

Jorge: Added. You should get an invite to the pager group and write perms on the runbook in ~5m. If not, ping me and I'll open a ticket with SRE infra.

Sam: Small note about coverage gaps: there is a timezone hole between 22:00-02:00 PT on weekdays where our current rota drops from 2 oncall to 1. Ben: can we run a follow-up to propose a floating secondary for those hours? I'd volunteer some shifted shifts if needed.

Ben: Agreed — let's do a quick rota tweak after the shadow week. For now, prioritize shadowing schedule and make sure Priya sees the handoffs. I'll send the formal handoff template DM to Priya and we can do a practice handoff on Friday 11am PT.

Priya: Thanks everyone — excited to get started. I'll RSVP to Maya's Tue slot and to the calendar invites.

Ben: Thanks all. Action items: 1) Maya — 2 pairing slots + simulated pages. 2) Jorge — update runbook checklist and grant perms. 3) Sam — propose rota tweak for 22:00-02:00 PT hole. 4) Priya — join Tue pairing and watch the simulated test alert. We'll do a practice handoff Fri 11am PT. :rocket:
